runtimeDivergences.title: Reusable Witch Dock notification / update-alert system
runtimeDivergences.reason: Dev is staging a loader-isolated generic one-time notification service plus a v2.3.0 Stable wrapper-update notice. Neither module is required by Core, preserving optional-feature failure isolation. Public Stable remains v2.2.2 until the combined #58/#83 release passes Dev and human gates.
acceptance: Generic notices are loader-isolated from Core and have stable IDs, one-time acknowledgement storage, queue/priority behavior, close/Escape handling, optional action links, and observable state.
Acknowledgement can occur on show, dismiss, or action; the v2.3.0 wrapper notice uses on-show acknowledgement so it never repeats after first display.
Release-specific notice copy is isolated from Core in a hidden module.
Stable trigger uses installed Tampermonkey wrapper evidence from KWWitchDockStableHost, not the self-hosted runtime version.
Stable users at v2.3.0 or newer do not see the wrapper-update notice.
Stable users on an older installed wrapper can see the notice even when the v2.3.0 runtime is self-hosted from current Stable.
Update action points to the canonical Witch_Scripts/Witch_Dock.user.js URL.
Dev preview and live loader regression pass; Amanda visually approves before the combined public release.
